title: docs: remove references to deprecated consumer and free tiers

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable request to update documentation by removing references to deprecated consumer account tiers and unpaid free tiers, including a specific list of target files and external context.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The task involves text edits across documentation files to strip deprecated tier references, requiring no logic or source code changes.

summary.problem: Gemini CLI documentation contains references to deprecated consumer account tiers (Gemini Code Assist for individuals, Google AI Pro/Ultra) and unpaid Free Tiers that will stop serving requests on June 18, 2026.
summary.root_cause: Documentation files have not been updated following the deprecation of individual consumer and free tiers.
summary.context: Removing outdated consumer/free tier details ensures the documentation accurately reflects supported Standard, Enterprise, and paid API tiers.

steps: Update README.md to remove references to individual Google accounts and unpaid free tier quotas.
Update ROADMAP.md to remove mentions of consumer and free tier features.
Update docs/changelogs/index.md to remove or update mentions of consumer/free tiers.
Update docs/cli/enterprise.md to adjust explanations regarding consumer accounts versus enterprise accounts.
Update docs/get-started/authentication.mdx to remove authentication options for individual consumer Google accounts.
Update docs/reference/commands.md to eliminate references to consumer/free tier specific options.
Update docs/resources/faq.md to remove questions and answers regarding free tiers and individual consumer accounts.
Update docs/resources/quota-and-pricing.md table and text to remove consumer and unpaid free tier entries.
Update docs/resources/tos-privacy.md to remove terms and references related to consumer/individual tiers.
Update docs/resources/troubleshooting.md to remove individual consumer account troubleshooting instructions.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Documentation accurately describes supported Standard, Enterprise, and paid API tiers without references to deprecated consumer or unpaid free tiers.
verification_steps: Search documentation files for terms like 'Free tier', 'Individual', 'Google AI Pro', and 'Google AI Ultra'.
Verify all references to deprecated consumer and unpaid free tiers have been removed or updated.
Check that remaining documentation clearly and accurately describes supported tiers.
